display_information.name: PawsOps Inventory Tracker
display_information.description: Answers stock questions per location and alerts on low supplies.
display_information.long_description:
Ask me "how much kibble is left at Location 2?" I also post low-stock alerts with a Reorder button.

Answers stock questions per location and alerts on low supplies.

This agent was built on PawsOps and deployed to Slack as its own app for Paws & Stay, a dog boarding business with three locations. All data in this demo is sample data.
